settings.enable_toast.label: Enable toast notifications
settings.enable_toast.description: Show a notification when the microphone, camera or screen sharing turns on.
settings.mic_filter.label: Microphone filter pattern
settings.mic_filter.description: Lua pattern that filters out microphone applications. Matching apps are completely excluded from detection. Separate multiple patterns with |, e.g. effect_input.rnnoise|easyeffects.
settings.cam_filter.label: Camera filter pattern
settings.cam_filter.description: Lua pattern that filters out camera applications. Matching apps are completely excluded from detection. Separate multiple patterns with |.
settings.hide_inactive.label: Hide inactive states
settings.hide_inactive.description: Hide the microphone, camera and screen icons when they are inactive, and hide the whole widget when nothing is being captured.
settings.icon_spacing.label: Icon spacing
settings.icon_spacing.description: Spacing between the indicator icons in pixels.
settings.active_color.label: Active icon color
settings.active_color.description: Color of the icons while that device is in use.
settings.inactive_color.label: Inactive icon color
settings.inactive_color.description: Color of the icons while that device is idle.
